title: Hostinger Black Friday 2026: it has started, runs to Dec 14, and SONAR20 takes another 20% off
seoTitle: Hostinger Black Friday 2026: runs to Dec 14 + SONAR20
description: Hostinger Black Friday 2026: SONAR20 gives an extra 20% on eligible new plans. See the tested Startup example and what to check about the total and renewal.
metaDescription: Hostinger Black Friday: SONAR20 gives an extra 20% on eligible plans. Compare the initial total and the renewal; on monthly billing, check it applies.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Hostinger's Black Friday runs until December 14, 2026. The campaign price applies automatically, and **SONAR20** gives an extra 20% on eligible new plans. On the 24-month KVM 1, the total dropped from US$ 155.76 to US$ 124.61. Compare the initial total and the renewal before choosing the term.

contentSections.heading: Has Hostinger's Black Friday started?
paragraphs: It has. Hostinger's official FAQ says: “Hostinger's Black Friday sale runs from October 19 to December 14, 2026.” The global page in English gives the same date.

On November 16, the global campaign page shows up to 85% off web hosting and up to 70% off VPS. Those are banner figures, calculated on each plan's full price: what you actually pay, plan by plan, is in the tables below.

contentSections.heading: Hosting: what the first period costs
paragraphs: Hostinger charges the whole period at once and shows the price divided by month. What leaves your pocket at sign-up is the total: the monthly equivalent is only for comparing plans.

comparisonTable.caption: Hostinger's global site in English, in US dollars, read in mid-November, on the 48-month plan. We checked the Cloud Startup in the cart; for the others, the total with SONAR20 is the same 20% calculation on the total.

postParagraphs: Some regional pages sell a Single plan (1 site, 10 GB). The global page in English did not show it on November 16, 2026, so it is not in the tables.

The prices are from Hostinger's global site in English on November 16, 2026, in US dollars. Before a billing address was entered, the cart showed estimated tax of 0%, so local tax may be added later. Converting to another currency is only an estimate. The total with SONAR20 is the period total minus 20%, rounded to the cent. Working from the rounded monthly price gives a few cents less and does not match the charge.

We checked in the cart, without logging in, the 24-month KVM 1 on November 16, 2026 (from US$ 155.76 to US$ 124.61, with the coupon SONAR20 applied) and the 48-month Cloud Startup on November 7, 2026 (from US$ 383.52 to US$ 306.82). On the other plans, the column is the same 20% calculation on the total the page shows. The cart shows the discount before payment: check yours.

contentSections.heading: VPS: what the first period costs
paragraphs: On the VPS, the campaign term we read is the 24-month one, also charged at once.

comparisonTable.caption: Hostinger's global site in English, in US dollars, read in mid-November, on the 24-month plan. We checked the KVM 1 in the cart; for the others, the total with SONAR20 is the 20% calculation on the total the page shows.

postParagraphs: **Shorter cycles.** On the KVM 1 with SONAR20, 24 months came to US$ 124.61 (US$ 5.19 per month, renewing at US$ 11.99 per month), 12 months to US$ 67.10 (US$ 5.59 per month, renewing at US$ 12.99 per month) and 1 month to US$ 7.99 (renewing at US$ 19.49 per month). A shorter term costs more per month and renews higher. In a Premium cart on another regional store, on the same day, the code was accepted at 12, 24 and 48 months and rejected on the 1-month plan, which had no campaign price. If you want to pay month by month, test the code in the cart before counting on it.

contentSections.heading: Renewal: what each plan costs afterwards
paragraphs: Renewal gets neither the campaign discount nor the code's. Compare the two columns before you choose: it is the difference between what you pay now and what you will pay to keep going.

comparisonTable.caption: Monthly price advertised on Hostinger's global site in mid-November: the campaign one, without the code, and the renewal one.

postParagraphs: **Renewal.** The 20% from SONAR20 applies to new eligible plans, also for existing customers who buy a new eligible plan. On the renewal of a plan you already have, and on standalone domain registration, the code gives no discount. The 24-month KVM 1, for example, renews at US$ 11.99 per month for the same period. We did not read the renewal cycle of the other plans. The full renewal math is in [Hostinger renewal price and SONAR20](/en/reviews/hostinger-renewal-price-coupon-sonar20).
Where to paste the code, step by step, is in [Hostinger SONAR20 coupon](/en/reviews/hostinger-coupon-code-referral).

contentSections.heading: Which hosting plan to choose: Premium, Unlimited or Cloud Startup
paragraphs: The choice depends on how many sites you will run and how they are built. The limits below are from Hostinger's plan page and limits documentation.
bullets: [Premium](https://www.hostinger.com/web-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): 3 sites and 20 GB of storage. It is what Hostinger's own FAQ recommends for most personal, business and WordPress sites. No Node.js applications.

[Unlimited](https://www.hostinger.com/web-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): unlimited sites, 50 GB of NVMe storage and daily backups. It is the first hosting plan with Node.js applications: the documentation lists up to 5 Node.js sites on it.

[Cloud Startup](https://www.hostinger.com/web-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): unlimited sites, 100 GB of NVMe storage and dedicated resources, with up to 10 Node.js sites. It comes in when traffic or the number of projects has outgrown what shared hosting holds.
postParagraphs: **Node.js changes the choice.** According to Hostinger's limits documentation, Premium has no Node.js sites. If you will publish a Next.js project, for example, you start on Unlimited or a Cloud plan. A WordPress or PHP site fits any of them.

Bruno, who runs this site, has been a Hostinger customer since 2024, with hosting, a VPS KVM 2, email and domains. Em Casa com Cecília runs on Node.js on a Business contract he signed that year. In today's lineup, Hostinger sells the old Business as Unlimited on most pages, and customers who already had Business keep their plan and its limits. The usage report on this site comes from that 2024 Business contract. To sign up today, check the features and limits of Unlimited and Cloud; the current plans were not tested here as equivalent to that contract.

If you are going with WordPress, what each plan includes is in [WordPress on Hostinger](/en/reviews/wordpress-on-hostinger). The free domain for the first year and its price afterwards are in [Hostinger domains: buy, transfer or keep it elsewhere](/en/reviews/hostinger-domain-buy-transfer-or-elsewhere).

contentSections.heading: Which VPS to choose: KVM 1, 2, 4 or 8
paragraphs: A VPS is for people who need to install software outside the control panel, have CPU and memory reserved, or reach the server as root. If you do not need those features, start by comparing managed hosting; hosting and VPS plans have different prices and responsibilities. The comparison is in [VPS or shared hosting](/en/reviews/vps-or-shared-hosting-which-to-choose).

bullets: [KVM 1](https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): 1 vCPU core, 4 GB of RAM and 50 GB of NVMe. For a personal project, a small site or a single application.
[KVM 2](https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): 2 cores, 8 GB of RAM and 100 GB. For growing sites, an online store or a few applications together. It is the VPS Bruno uses.
[KVM 4](https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): 4 cores, 16 GB of RAM and 200 GB. For a database, several services or heavy traffic.
[KVM 8](https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting?REFERRALCODE=SONAR20): 8 cores, 32 GB of RAM and 400 GB. For agencies and applications that need a lot of memory.
postParagraphs: **To run OpenClaw:** with the model accessed through an API, the KVM 1 is a starting point. If you plan to run the model on the server itself, choose the setup by the model, the context size and the memory available. OpenClaw's documentation warns that the minimum memory does not guarantee fast execution. Before signing up for that use, see [Best VPS for OpenClaw](/en/reviews/best-vps-for-openclaw).

contentSections.heading: Who should wait and who shouldn't
paragraphs: If you need your site online this week, compare the total available today, with and without SONAR20, plus the renewal price. The code reduces the campaign price; that does not guarantee the lowest price through the end of Black Friday.

If you can wait, keep in mind that the campaign runs until mid-December, but no price is guaranteed until then. The 20% from SONAR20 comes off the campaign price: if the campaign changes, the total changes with it.
If you are already a customer, check the upgrade offers in your account: the FAQ says existing customers may get separate offers. SONAR20 also works for a new eligible plan.

contentSections.heading: How to check before you pay
bullets: Open [Hostinger on this site's store page](/en/coupons/hostinger) and copy the code SONAR20.
In the cart, paste SONAR20 into the coupon field and check that the 20% discount line appears on the plan and term you chose.
Compare the total for the first period, not just the monthly price. The total shows the real difference.
Change the period in the cart before you check out: the monthly equivalent can be the same across different terms, and the term decides when the renewal arrives.

Check the renewal price before you check out. Hostinger shows it before payment, and it is not the campaign price. The 20% from SONAR20 applies to new eligible plans, also for existing customers; renewal is charged at the list price.
postParagraphs: Before paying, the company's review record is in [Hostinger on Trustpilot](/en/reviews/hostinger-trustpilot-reviews), and what the guarantee covers and what it leaves out is in [Is Hostinger legit?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does Hostinger's Black Friday start and how long does it last? It has already started and runs until mid-December; the exact dates are in the quick answer at the top. The global page shows up to 85% off web hosting and up to 70% off VPS.
Does Hostinger's Black Friday have a coupon? The campaign price applies automatically, and SONAR20, in the cart's coupon field, gives an extra 20% on eligible new plans.

Which Hostinger plan should I buy on Black Friday? For up to three WordPress or PHP sites, Premium. For Node.js or many sites, Unlimited. For heavy traffic, Cloud Startup. A VPS only if you need root, software outside the panel or reserved memory. Some regional pages also sell a Single plan for one site, which the global page did not list on November 16.
Does Hostinger's Premium plan run Node.js? No. According to Hostinger's limits documentation, Node.js sites start on Unlimited, with up to 5, and on the Cloud plans, with up to 10.

Which Hostinger VPS works for OpenClaw? With the model accessed through an API, the KVM 1 is a starting point. To run the model on the server itself, the choice depends on the model, the context size and the memory available: see [Best VPS for OpenClaw](/en/reviews/best-vps-for-openclaw) before you sign up.
Does the Black Friday price carry over to renewal? No. It applies to the initial period of the subscription. Renewal is charged at the plan's regular price.
Does SONAR20 work together with the Black Friday price? Yes: on eligible new plans, the 20% comes off the campaign price. Since the price changes, check the total in the cart.

Does SONAR20 work on the 1-month plan? It depends on the plan. In our tests in mid-November, the code went through on the 1-month KVM 1 and was rejected on a 1-month Premium on another regional store. Test it in your cart before you pay.

Does the refund guarantee apply on Black Friday? The FAQ says eligible plans have a 30-day guarantee, with terms and exclusions. What it leaves out is in [Is Hostinger legit?](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

Does SONAR20 work for people who are already Hostinger customers? Yes, if you buy a new eligible plan. SONAR20 does not discount the renewal of a plan you already have or a standalone domain registration. Check the application on the plan and term you chose.
